 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.

Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
The equipment must be fully isolated mechanically and electrically.
Isolated equipment circuit breaker, off position.
Complete tool set.
Lifting ropes, Wooden blocks.
Cleaning fluids,
Discharge the liquid from the pump body.
Disconnect the suction and discharge line.

Start 
 the disassembly operation at the discharge end of the pump.

Unscrew 
 the screw on the bearing cover.

Remove 
 bearing cover.

Unscrew 
 grooved nut and remove lock washer.

Disassembly the bearing housing by unscrews the bolt nut and removes the 
 washer.

Remove 
 the discharge casing together with packing and gland packing.

Extract 
 spare bush and shaft sleeve.

Then 
 remove the packing.

Remove 
 diffuses and impeller and intermediate casing and spare bush.

Repeat 
 this operation until all stages are removed.
Reassembly by performing the above reverse order.
Check clearance of impeller.
Check the condition of bearing.
Check the condition of shafts.

Introduction
This document lists the minor maintenance 
procedure P1, 
which must be performed every four years or 40.000 operation hours bases as indicated in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed El-Sabagh & eng. Adel Saad Zaghlool, 
 revised by eng. Mohamed selim & eng. Sobhy Abel Halim, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Mohamed Abd Elghaffar, and approved by Al Aresh PS Head Sector

 The internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim.
Safety Precautions

Disassembly

Disconnect the suction and discharge line.
Start

Remove 
 bearing cover.

Then
